title: TypedArray atomic access index and length overflow fix
root_cause: The published integer-overflow fix replaces signed typed-array length/index conversion and unchecked access arithmetic with unsigned conversion and an index-before-length guard in AtomicHelper::ValidateAtomicAccess.
notes: Historical benchmark evidence only. The fix commit is a multi-file cherry-pick; this manifest binds the primary atomic-helper source and symbol named by the verified patch.
